image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a chiton (marine mollusk) clinging to a rocky substrate. The organism displays an elongated oval shape with a distinct dorsal armor consisting of eight overlapping calcareous plates in yellow and orange hues, surrounded by a pinkish-purple leathery girdle. The background consists of blurred, textured rock surfaces.
